hoaxes.title: Axiom will print its 43-million-line proof as a 15,000-volume boxed set
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Axiom says it verified the Classification of Finite Simple Groups in Lean, in about 43.1 million lines.

hoaxes.title: Peacock adds a silent film mode to Minions & Monsters that mutes all the dialogue
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Minions & Monsters, set in 1927 Hollywood, began streaming on Peacock on October 28.

hoaxes.title: Xbox's free-games offer for PC buyers adds a gamerscore bonus for unboxing the PC
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Buyers of eligible Windows 11 PCs from November 2 can claim 25 Xbox games at no extra cost.

hoaxes.title: Apple's new Numbers assistant grades your spreadsheets from A to F
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Pages, Keynote and Numbers get an AI assistant, and macOS 27 lets outside agents connect via MCP.
